claims.claim: For every actual byte slice, without a valid-input or allocation-success antecedent, the independent Strict MI excludes OutsideDomain. A checked actual Strict walk plus one fixed stack window instantiates the accepted M2 total measuring contract. The certificate calls neither the public ICC entry nor any allocator; the shipping decoder never executes it.

The independent P17 model completes the entire Strict structural walk before profile inflation. A walk error preserves its exact error and has no request; no iCCP returns Absent and has no request. ICC does not decode default-image pixels.

A present profile requests IccWindow(WINDOW_MAX), followed by Icc(m) if and only if measurement ends Done, with m exactly the model output length. A measurement error or Full has only the Window request; m=0 remains an explicit Icc(0) request. There are at most two requests, both within their exact site bounds and MAX_BYTES. Every returned model profile is at most MAX_ICC bytes.

After successful walk with a present profile, IccProfileTooLarge occurs exactly when the MAX_ICC Strict measurement returns Full. Inflater format faults map to their exact PNG errors, never IccProfileTooLarge, and no Icc reservation precedes that measuring decision.

For a successful measurement bounded by MAX_ICC, instantiate the already accepted M2 L-LIMIT-MONO with small=m=the model output length and large=MAX_ICC. The exact-sized second model pass is Done with identical bytes, including m=0. This is composition of an imported theorem, not a new DEFLATE or monotonicity proof.
